title: ViparSpectra LED Aquarium Light Setup
author: Jack C Koch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j5zcq76

steps.title: Set Device Clock
steps.instruction: Configure the current time using either the remote or the on-light controls.

substeps.instruction: Using remote: Press Clock button, use up/down to set hour, press OK, use up/down to set minute, and wait for H-SE to appear.

Using on-light controls: Press knob repeatedly until H-SE appears, turn knob until Cloc appears, press knob to select hour, turn knob to set hour, press knob to select minute, turn knob to set minute, and wait for H-SE to appear.

steps.title: Adjust Light Intensity
steps.instruction: Set the light intensity (0-100%) for channels Ch1 and Ch2.

substeps.instruction: Using remote: Press menu until H-SE appears, press OK until Ch1 appears, use up/down to set intensity (0-100%), press OK until Ch2 appears, use up/down to set intensity (0-100%), press OK until H-SE appears, and wait for time to be shown.

Using on-light controls: Press knob repeatedly until Ch1 appears, turn knob to set intensity (0-100%), press knob repeatedly until Ch2 appears, turn knob to set intensity (0-100%), press knob repeatedly until H-SE appears, and wait for time to be shown.

steps.title: Configure Timer Settings
steps.instruction: Set the On and Off times for channels C1 and C2.

substeps.instruction: Using remote: Press C1 On button, use up/down to select hour slot and set hour, press OK to select minute slot and set minute, and wait for H-SE to appear. Repeat this process for C1 Off, C2 On, and C2 Off.

Using on-light controls: Press knob repeatedly until H-SE appears, turn knob until C1 On appears, press knob to select hour slot, turn knob to set hour, press knob to select minute slot, turn knob to set minute, and wait for H-SE to appear. Repeat this process for C1 Off, C2 On, and C2 Off.

steps.title: Power the Device
steps.instruction: Turn the device on or off.

substeps.instruction: Using remote: Press the power button.
Using on-light controls: Press and hold the knob for a few seconds until 'on' or 'off' appears on screen, then release the knob.
